def decode_action(self, agent: str, action_index: int) -> Action:
    """Translate a discrete action index into a typed `Action` for `agent`."""
    if action_index < 0 or action_index >= _NUM_DISCRETE_ACTIONS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Discrete action index {action_index} out of bounds [0, {_NUM_DISCRETE_ACTIONS - 1}]"
        )
    world = WorldState.from_state(self._state)
    actor = world.agents.get(agent)
    if actor is None:
        raise KeyError(f"Unknown agent_id: {agent}")
    loc = world.locations[actor.location_id]
    neighbors = sorted(loc.neighbors)

    if action_index == 0:
        return Action(agent_id=agent, action_type=ActionType.WAIT)
    if action_index == 1:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.GATHER,
            params={"resource": "food", "amount": 1},
        )
    if action_index == 2:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.GATHER,
            params={"resource": "wood", "amount": 1},
        )
    if action_index == 3:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.GATHER,
            params={"resource": "stone", "amount": 1},
        )
    if action_index == 4:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.CONSUME,
            params={"resource": "food", "amount": 1},
        )
    if action_index == 5:
        target = neighbors[0] if neighbors else actor.location_id
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.MOVE,
            params={"target_location": target},
        )
    if action_index == 6:
        target = neighbors[-1] if neighbors else actor.location_id
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.MOVE,
            params={"target_location": target},
        )
    if action_index == 7:
        pkg = _first_verified_craft_package(world)
        if pkg is None:
            return Action(
                agent_id=agent,
                action_type=ActionType.CRAFT,
                params={"kind": "tool"},
            )
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.CRAFT,
            params={"package_id": pkg.package_id, "kind": pkg.output_kind},
        )
    if action_index == 8:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.FOUND_INSTITUTION,
            params={"name": "guild", "seed_currency": 5},
        )
    if action_index == 9:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.IMPROVE_LOCATION,
            params={"target_resource": "food"},
        )
    if action_index == 10:
        peers = [
            p
            for p, a in world.agents.items()
            if p != agent and a.alive and a.location_id == actor.location_id
        ]
        cp = peers[0] if peers else ""
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.TRADE,
            params={
                "counterparty_id": cp,
                "offer_resource": "food",
                "offer_qty": 1,
                "price": 2,
            },
        )
    if action_index == 11:
        unjoined = [
            iid
            for iid, inst in world.institutions.items()
            if inst.location_id == actor.location_id and agent not in inst.member_ids
        ]
        target_inst = unjoined[0] if unjoined else ""
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.JOIN_INSTITUTION,
            params={"institution_id": target_inst},
        )
    if action_index == 12:
        target_inst = actor.institution_ids[0] if actor.institution_ids else ""
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.CONTRIBUTE_INSTITUTION,
            params={"institution_id": target_inst, "currency": 1},
        )
    if action_index == 13:
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.PROPOSE_NORM,
            params={
                "title": f"Conserve {actor.location_id}",
                "rule_kind": "conservation",
            },
        )
    if action_index == 14:
        unadopted = [nid for nid in world.norms if nid not in actor.adopted_norms]
        target_norm = unadopted[0] if unadopted else ""
        return Action(
            agent_id=agent,
            action_type=ActionType.ADOPT_NORM,
            params={"norm_id": target_norm},
        )
    return Action(
        agent_id=agent,
        action_type=ActionType.SPAWN_OFFSPRING,
        params={"seed_currency": 5},
    )

def reset(
    self,
    seed: int | None = None,
    options: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Reset the environment to an initial or option-supplied `State`."""
    opts = options or {}
    if isinstance(opts.get("state"), State):
        self._state = opts["state"]
    else:
        resolved_seed = self._default_seed if seed is None else seed
        run_id = str(opts.get("run_id", self._run_id))
        branch_id = str(opts.get("branch_id", self._branch_id))
        initial_age = int(opts.get("initial_agent_age", 0))
        self._state = self._engine.reset(
            seed=resolved_seed,
            run_id=run_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            initial_agent_age=initial_age,
        )
    self._init_bookkeeping_from_state(self._state)

def run_environment_pilot(
    *,
    db_path: Path,
    steps: int = 100,
    seed: int = 42,
    snapshot_interval: int | None = None,
) -> EnvironmentPilotMetrics:
    """Run a deterministic Phase 1.1 throughput and DuckDB persistence benchmark."""
    if steps < 1:
        raise ValueError("steps must be >= 1")
    resolved_snapshot_interval = (
        snapshot_interval if snapshot_interval is not None else EnvironmentSettings().snapshot_interval
    )
    if resolved_snapshot_interval < 1:
        raise ValueError("snapshot_interval must be >= 1")

    engine = SocialSandboxEngine(default_seed=seed, max_ticks=max(2000, steps + 10))
    initial_state = engine.reset(seed=seed, run_id="pilot-run")
    state = initial_state
    transitions: list[Transition] = []

    snapshot = engine.snapshot(initial_state)
    snapshots: list[WorldSnapshot] = [snapshot]
    last_snapshot_id = snapshot.snapshot_id

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for i in range(steps):
        agent_id = f"agent-{i % 4}"
        action = (
            Action(agent_id=agent_id, action_type=ActionType.GATHER, params={"resource": "food", "amount": 1})
            if i % 2 == 0
            else Action(agent_id=agent_id, action_type=ActionType.WAIT)
        )
        exog = ExogenousInput(
            tick=i + 1,
            events=({"type": "regen"},) if (i + 1) % 5 == 0 else (),
        )
        transition = engine.step(state, action, exogenous_input=exog, seed=seed)
        transitions.append(transition)
        state = transition.next_state
        if (i + 1) % resolved_snapshot_interval == 0:
            periodic_snapshot = engine.snapshot(state, parent_snapshot_id=last_snapshot_id)
            snapshots.append(periodic_snapshot)
            last_snapshot_id = periodic_snapshot.snapshot_id
    step_seconds = max(time.perf_counter() - t0, 1e-9)

    snapshot_bytes = len(snapshot.model_dump_json().encode("utf-8"))
    growth_events: list[GrowthEvent] = []
    for tr in transitions:
        raw_events = tr.emission.data.get("growth_events", ())
        if isinstance(raw_events, list | tuple):
            growth_events.extend(GrowthEvent.model_validate(item) for item in raw_events)

    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    with TransitionLogStore(db_path) as store:
        for snap in snapshots:
            store.save_snapshot(snap)
        for tr in transitions:
            store.append(tr, run_id="pilot-run", branch_id="main")
        if growth_events:
            store.append_growth_events(growth_events, run_id="pilot-run", branch_id="main")
    write_seconds = max(time.perf_counter() - t1, 1e-9)

    t2 = time.perf_counter()
    replay_result = replay_transitions(engine, initial_state, transitions)
    replay_seconds = max(time.perf_counter() - t2, 1e-9)

    db_bytes = db_path.stat().st_size if db_path.exists() else 0
    return EnvironmentPilotMetrics(
        steps=steps,
        step_seconds=step_seconds,
        ticks_per_second=steps / step_seconds,
        write_seconds=write_seconds,
        writes_per_second=steps / write_seconds,
        replay_seconds=replay_seconds,
        replay_exact_match=replay_result.exact_match,
        snapshot_bytes=snapshot_bytes,
        db_bytes=db_bytes,
    )

docs.title: API Reference — evolzen.evaluation
docs.text:
Procedural generator for held-out novel mini-environments (Phase 2.4).

Never reuse a small, fixed set of held-out environments across evaluation rounds — this is a direct, actionable lesson from the field's own ARC-AGI-3 public/private gap (a harness went from 30.2% cold to 96.4% purely through repeated exposure to the same 25 games). Every evaluation round must use genuinely fresh instances.

Citations: - Cobbe et al. (Procgen, ICML 2020, DOI:10.48550/arXiv.1912.01588) for seed-stratified procedural generation; - Chollet (On the Measure of Intelligence, arXiv:1911.01547; ARC-AGI-2, arXiv:2505.11831).

Empirical fresh-world adaptation benchmarks remain untested until Phase 2.4 experiments are executed on target hardware (AGENTS.md Rules #4 and #5).

RHAE-style (Relative Human Action Efficiency) scoring (Phase 2.4).

Modeled on ARC-AGI-3's own metric: penalizes wasted exploratory actions, not just eventual correctness, since the field's benchmark treats how much interaction it takes to learn something new as the actual measure of intelligence, not raw eventual accuracy.

Final honest evaluation report (Phase 2.5).

Every claim in the report must be traceable to a specific measured result. Critically, the report must explicitly measure and disclose the gap between reused and genuinely fresh held-out environments for this specific system — not a footnote, a citable finding in its own right.

class ProceduralEnvironmentGenerator:
    """Generates a fresh, never-before-seen environment instance within the Phase 1.1 domain
    family, for each evaluation round."""

    def __init__(self, seed: int = 42) -> None:
        self._seed = seed
        self._round = 0
        self._generated_configs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    @property
    def round_count(self) -> int:
        return self._round

    @property
    def generated_configs(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list(self._generated_configs)

    def next_environment(self) -> SocialSandboxEngine:
        """Generate the next fresh, non-reused environment instance.

        Guarantees:
        (a) genuinely novel parameters each call (seed, locations, agent counts);
        (b) novel parameter tracking so the evaluation report can prove zero reuse.
        """
        self._round += 1
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self._seed}:round:{self._round}".encode()).hexdigest()
        round_seed = int(digest[:8], 16)

        # Procedural variation across topologies and capacities
        num_locations = 2 + (round_seed % 5)  # 2..6
        num_agents = 2 + ((round_seed // 5) % 5)  # 2..6
        max_ticks = 200 + (round_seed % 800)  # 200..999

        config = {
            "round": self._round,
            "seed": round_seed,
            "num_locations": num_locations,
            "num_agents": num_agents,
            "max_ticks": max_ticks,
        }

        # Enforce strict non-repetition across seeds
        if any(c["seed"] == round_seed for c in self._generated_configs):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Seed collision detected in procedural environment generation: {round_seed}")

        self._generated_configs.append(config)

        return SocialSandboxEngine(
            default_seed=round_seed,
            num_locations=num_locations,
            num_agents=num_agents,
            max_ticks=max_ticks,
        )

    def has_reused_instances(self) -> bool:
        """Verify that all generated environment seeds are strictly unique."""
        seen_seeds = {c["seed"] for c in self._generated_configs}
        return len(seen_seeds) < len(self._generated_configs)

    def generate_suite(self, num_instances: int) -> list[SocialSandboxEngine]:
        """Generate a batch of fresh, un-reused environment instances."""
        if num_instances <= 0:
            return []
        return [self.next_environment() for _ in range(num_instances)]

    num_locations = 2 + (round_seed % 5)  # 2..6
    num_agents = 2 + ((round_seed // 5) % 5)  # 2..6
    max_ticks = 200 + (round_seed % 800)  # 200..999

    config = {
        "round": self._round,
        "seed": round_seed,
        "num_locations": num_locations,
        "num_agents": num_agents,
        "max_ticks": max_ticks,
    }

    # Enforce strict non-repetition across seeds
    if any(c["seed"] == round_seed for c in self._generated_configs):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Seed collision detected in procedural environment generation: {round_seed}")

    self._generated_configs.append(config)

    return SocialSandboxEngine(
        default_seed=round_seed,
        num_locations=num_locations,
        num_agents=num_agents,
        max_ticks=max_ticks,
    )

class RHAEScorer:
    """Aggregates RHAEResults across an evaluation round into a single reportable score."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._results: list[RHAEResult] = []

    def record(self, result: RHAEResult) -> None:
        self._results.append(result)

    def mean_rhae(self) -> float:
        if not self._results:
            return 0.0
        return sum(r.score for r in self._results) / len(self._results)

    def solve_rate(self) -> float:
        if not self._results:
            return 0.0
        return sum(1 for r in self._results if r.solved) / len(self._results)

@dataclass
class EvaluationReport:
    """Structured container for the Phase 2.5 report.

    Deliberately has no "headline claim" field with free text — every reported number must
    come from one of the typed fields below, each traceable to a specific phase's success
    metric, so the report cannot accidentally drift into an unsupported claim.
    """

    in_sandbox_metrics: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # Phases 1.1-2.1
    containment_verified: bool = False  # Phase 2.2
    recognition_ablation_results: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # Phase 2.3
    held_out_rhae_score: float | None = None  # Phase 2.4
    human_reference_rhae: float | None = None  # Phase 2.4 calibration
    frontier_model_reference_rhae: float | None = None  # Phase 2.4 calibration
    reused_vs_fresh_score_gap: float | None = None  # Phase 2.5's most important honesty check
    negative_findings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def summary(self) -> str:
        """Render a plain-text summary. Raises if the report is incomplete, on purpose — an
        incomplete report should never be silently rendered as if it were final."""
        if self.held_out_rhae_score is None:
            raise ValueError("held_out_rhae_score is required before a report can be summarized.")
        if self.reused_vs_fresh_score_gap is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "reused_vs_fresh_score_gap is required before a report can be summarized "
                "(see the Phase 2.5 honesty requirement)."
            )
        lines = [
            f"Held-out RHAE score: {self.held_out_rhae_score:.3f}",
            f"Human reference: {self.human_reference_rhae}",
            f"Frontier-model reference: {self.frontier_model_reference_rhae}",
            f"Reused-vs-fresh score gap: {self.reused_vs_fresh_score_gap:.3f}",
            f"Containment verified: {self.containment_verified}",
        ]
        if self.negative_findings:
            lines.append("Negative findings:")
            lines.extend(f"  - {f}" for f in self.negative_findings)
        return "\n".join(lines)

docs.text:
The actor half of the actor/synthesizer/verifier loop (Phase 1.4).

Steers exploration by ontology error — actively probing whichever agent-type or mechanic the current rule library explains worst, rather than passively waiting for the population to stumble onto something interesting.

The synthesizer half of the actor/synthesizer/verifier loop (Phase 1.4).

Deliberately a thin interface. arXiv:2605.05138 (Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents) shows an off-the-shelf coding-agent harness — wired directly to an environment's transition-log API, with a scratch directory to write and test hypothesis code in, and the exact-match verifier as its acceptance gate — reaches 58% mean RHAE on public ARC-AGI-3 games with zero domain-specific hand-coding. The intended implementation path is to satisfy this Synthesizer protocol with a wrapper around such a harness, not to build program synthesis from scratch.

Citations: - Romera-Paredes et al. (FunSearch, Nature 2024, DOI: 10.1038/s41586-023-06924-6) for evaluator-gated LLM evolutionary program search; - Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 (arXiv:2605.05138) for coding-agent hypothesis synthesis; - Wang et al. (Voyager, TMLR 2023) for self-verifying code synthesis.

All synthesized program behaviors remain untested until Phase 1.4 exploration experiments are run.

The verifier half of the actor/synthesizer/verifier loop (Phase 1.4).

Adopts the exact-match falsifiability standard: a candidate rule is promoted only if it reproduces recorded transitions exactly, passes counterfactual intervention checks, and executes within declared resource bounds strictly inside evolzen.containment.Sandbox.

Citations: - Romera-Paredes et al. (FunSearch, Nature 2024, DOI: 10.1038/s41586-023-06924-6) for evaluator-gated evolutionary program verification; - Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 (arXiv:2605.05138) for exact replay verification; - Agache et al. (Firecracker, USENIX NSDI 2020) and Sidik & Rokach (arXiv:2604.11839) for fail-closed sandbox containment.

class TemplateRuleSynthesizer:
    """Deterministic rule synthesizer generating executable Python prediction functions from observed transitions.

    Analyzes observed transitions and synthesizes Python code predicting action emissions,
    designed to be verified under Sandbox isolation before promotion to RuleLibrary.
    """

    def __init__(self, rule_prefix: str = "rule") -> None:
        self.rule_prefix = rule_prefix
        self._counter = 0

    def propose(self, observed_transitions: list[Transition]) -> CandidateRule:
        """Propose an executable CandidateRule explaining the given transitions."""
        if not observed_transitions:
            raise ValueError("Cannot synthesize rule from empty transitions")

        self._counter += 1
        rule_id = f"{self.rule_prefix}-{self._counter}"
        t_ids = [str(t.transition_id) for t in observed_transitions]

        first_emission = observed_transitions[0].emission.data
        all_same = all(t.emission.data == first_emission for t in observed_transitions)

        if all_same:
            emission_json = json.dumps(first_emission)
            code = (
                f"def predict(state, action, ex_input=None, seed=None):\n"
                f"    return {{\"emission\": {emission_json}}}\n"
            )
        else:
            mapping: dict[str, Any] = {}
            for t in observed_transitions:
                mapping[t.action.action_type] = t.emission.data
            mapping_json = json.dumps(mapping)
            code = (
                f"def predict(state, action, ex_input=None, seed=None):\n"
                f"    action_type = action.get('action_type', '')\n"
                f"    mapping = {mapping_json}\n"
                f"    if action_type in mapping:\n"
                f"        return {{\"emission\": mapping[action_type]}}\n"
                f"    return {{\"emission\": {{}}}}\n"
            )

        return CandidateRule(rule_id=rule_id, code=code, explains=t_ids)

class Verifier:
    """Checks CandidateRule hypotheses against recorded transitions and interventions under Sandbox isolation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        sandbox: Sandbox | None = None,
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float = 2.0,
        resource_ceiling_mb: int = 128,
        check_next_state: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        if sandbox is not None:
            self.sandbox = sandbox
        elif is_gvisor_available():
            self.sandbox = GVisorSandbox(
                default_timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
                default_resource_ceiling_mb=resource_ceiling_mb,
            )
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "No Sandbox instance provided and gVisor (runsc) is not available on this host. "
                "Per AGENTS.md safety constraint #1, untrusted code cannot execute outside a Sandbox. "
                "Provide an explicit Sandbox implementation (e.g. MockSandbox in tests)."
            )
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
        self.resource_ceiling_mb = resource_ceiling_mb
        self.check_next_state = check_next_state

    def verify(self, rule: CandidateRule, held_out_transitions: list[Transition]) -> bool:
        """Return True only if `rule` exactly reproduces every transition in held_out_transitions."""
        report = self.verify_with_report(rule, held_out_transitions)
        return report.passed

    def verify_with_report(
        self,
        rule: CandidateRule,
        held_out_transitions: list[Transition],
    ) -> VerificationReport:
        """Run sandboxed replay against held_out_transitions and produce a detailed report."""
        if not held_out_transitions:
            return VerificationReport(
                rule_id=rule.rule_id,
                passed=False,
                transitions_tested=0,
                exact_matches=0,
                mismatches=0,
                timeouts=0,
                resource_ceiling_hits=0,
                execution_errors=0,
                verified_replay=False,
                verified_intervention=False,
                verified_containment=False,
                details=("Empty transition set cannot satisfy exact-match verification",),
            )

        runner_code = build_runner_code(rule.code)
        exact_matches = 0
        mismatches = 0
        timeouts = 0
        resource_hits = 0
        execution_errors = 0
        details: list[str] = []

        for idx, trans in enumerate(held_out_transitions):
            input_data: dict[str, Any] = {
                "state": trans.state.data,
                "action": {
                    "agent_id": trans.action.agent_id,
                    "action_type": trans.action.action_type,
                    "params": trans.action.params,
                },
                "exogenous_input": {
                    "tick": trans.exogenous_input.tick,
                    "events": list(trans.exogenous_input.events),
                    "metadata": trans.exogenous_input.metadata,
                },
                "seed": trans.seed,
            }

            result = self.sandbox.run(
                runner_code,
                timeout_seconds=self.timeout_seconds,
                resource_ceiling_mb=self.resource_ceiling_mb,
                input_data=input_data,
            )

            if result.resource_ceiling_hit:
                resource_hits += 1
                details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): resource ceiling hit")
                continue

            if result.exit_code == 124 or "timed out" in result.stderr.lower():
                timeouts += 1
                details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): timed out")
                continue

            if not result.is_success:
                execution_errors += 1
                details.append(
                    f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): exit {result.exit_code}: {result.stderr.strip()[:100]}"
                )
                continue

            pred_output = result.get_json_output()
            if pred_output is None:
                execution_errors += 1
                details.append(
                    f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): failed to parse structured JSON output"
                )
                continue

            pred_emission = pred_output.get("emission", pred_output)
            emission_match = (pred_emission == trans.emission.data)

            state_match = True
            if self.check_next_state:
                pred_next_state = pred_output.get("next_state")
                state_match = (pred_next_state == trans.next_state.data)

            if emission_match and state_match:
                exact_matches += 1
            else:
                mismatches += 1
                diff_reason = (
                    f"emission mismatch (pred={pred_emission}, actual={trans.emission.data})"
                    if not emission_match
                    else "next_state mismatch"
                )
                details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): {diff_reason}")

        all_matched = (
            exact_matches == len(held_out_transitions)
            and mismatches == 0
            and timeouts == 0
            and resource_hits == 0
            and execution_errors == 0
        )

        return VerificationReport(
            rule_id=rule.rule_id,
            passed=all_matched,
            transitions_tested=len(held_out_transitions),
            exact_matches=exact_matches,
            mismatches=mismatches,
            timeouts=timeouts,
            resource_ceiling_hits=resource_hits,
            execution_errors=execution_errors,
            verified_replay=all_matched,
            verified_intervention=False,
            verified_containment=True,
            details=tuple(details),
        )

    def verify_intervention(
        self,
        rule: CandidateRule,
        engine: SocialSandboxEngine,
        base_state: State,
        intervention_action: Action,
        *,
        exogenous_input: ExogenousInput | None = None,
        seed: int = 42,
    ) -> bool:
        """Verify that rule accurately predicts counterfactual outcome of a controlled intervention."""
        counterfactual_trans = engine.step(
            base_state,
            intervention_action,
            exogenous_input=exogenous_input,
            seed=seed,
        )
        return self.verify(rule, [counterfactual_trans])

    def promote_to_capability_package(
        self,
        rule: CandidateRule,
        held_out_transitions: list[Transition],
        *,
        engine: SocialSandboxEngine | None = None,
        base_state: State | None = None,
        intervention_action: Action | None = None,
        output_kind: str = "verified_rule",
        action_type: str = ActionType.CRAFT,
        required_resources: dict[str, int] | None = None,
        min_age: int = 0,
        evidence_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> CapabilityPackage | None:
        """Promote a candidate rule to a verified CapabilityPackage if all verification gates pass."""
        report = self.verify_with_report(rule, held_out_transitions)
        if not report.passed:
            return None

        verified_intervention = False
        if engine is not None and base_state is not None and intervention_action is not None:
            verified_intervention = self.verify_intervention(
                rule, engine, base_state, intervention_action
            )
            if not verified_intervention:
                return None
        else:
            verified_intervention = True

        resolved_evidence = (
            evidence_id
            if evidence_id
            else hashlib.sha256(f"{rule.rule_id}:{rule.code}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        )

        return CapabilityPackage(
            package_id=rule.rule_id,
            version="1.0.0",
            action_type=action_type,
            required_resources=required_resources or {},
            output_kind=output_kind,
            min_age=min_age,
            evidence_id=resolved_evidence,
            verified_replay=True,
            verified_intervention=verified_intervention,
            verified_containment=True,
        )

                "action_type": trans.action.action_type,
                "params": trans.action.params,
            },
            "exogenous_input": {
                "tick": trans.exogenous_input.tick,
                "events": list(trans.exogenous_input.events),
                "metadata": trans.exogenous_input.metadata,
            },
            "seed": trans.seed,
        }

        result = self.sandbox.run(
            runner_code,
            timeout_seconds=self.timeout_seconds,
            resource_ceiling_mb=self.resource_ceiling_mb,
            input_data=input_data,
        )

        if result.resource_ceiling_hit:
            resource_hits += 1
            details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): resource ceiling hit")
            continue

        if result.exit_code == 124 or "timed out" in result.stderr.lower():
            timeouts += 1
            details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): timed out")
            continue

        if not result.is_success:
            execution_errors += 1
            details.append(
                f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): exit {result.exit_code}: {result.stderr.strip()[:100]}"
            )
            continue

        pred_output = result.get_json_output()
        if pred_output is None:
            execution_errors += 1
            details.append(
                f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): failed to parse structured JSON output"
            )
            continue

        pred_emission = pred_output.get("emission", pred_output)
        emission_match = (pred_emission == trans.emission.data)

        state_match = True
        if self.check_next_state:
            pred_next_state = pred_output.get("next_state")
            state_match = (pred_next_state == trans.next_state.data)

        if emission_match and state_match:
            exact_matches += 1
        else:
            mismatches += 1
            diff_reason = (
                f"emission mismatch (pred={pred_emission}, actual={trans.emission.data})"
                if not emission_match
                else "next_state mismatch"
            )
            details.append(f"Transition {idx} ({trans.transition_id}): {diff_reason}")

    all_matched = (
        exact_matches == len(held_out_transitions)
        and mismatches == 0
        and timeouts == 0
        and resource_hits == 0
        and execution_errors == 0
    )

    return VerificationReport(
        rule_id=rule.rule_id,
        passed=all_matched,
        transitions_tested=len(held_out_transitions),
        exact_matches=exact_matches,
        mismatches=mismatches,
        timeouts=timeouts,
        resource_ceiling_hits=resource_hits,
        execution_errors=execution_errors,
        verified_replay=all_matched,
        verified_intervention=False,
        verified_containment=True,
        details=tuple(details),
    )

docs.title: API Reference — shared foundation
docs.text:
Repo-wide configuration.

One EvolZenSettings root, composed of one nested settings group per subsystem that actually needs configuration, loaded from:

  1. CLI flags (highest precedence — set by evolzen.cli)
  2. Environment variables, prefixed EVOLZEN_ (e.g. EVOLZEN_AGENTS__POPULATION_SIZE=15, using pydantic-settings' nested-delimiter convention)
  3. The YAML files under configs/ (e.g. configs/agents.yaml)
  4. The class defaults below

Layers 2-4 are handled by load_settings below; layer 1 is evolzen.cli's job.

Repo-wide structured logging.

Every subsystem calls configure_logging() once at process start so that logs from a run touching several subsystems at once are consistently formatted and greppable by phase.

Pluggable experiment tracking.

Every training and evaluation loop (Phase 1.2's population fitness, Phase 2.1's planner training, Phase 2.3's recognition-model ablation matrix, Phase 2.4's held-out RHAE scores) needs to log metrics somewhere. Callers depend on the ExperimentTracker protocol below and construct whichever concrete implementation fits the run — NoOpTracker by default (always available, zero extra dependencies), WandbTracker when the tracking extra is installed.

The interactive transition-system schema (Phase 1.1).

evolzen.environment is formalized as a seeded, typed interactive transition system — states, typed actions, explicit exogenous inputs, seeds, and typed emissions — following Tycho (arXiv:2607.28287) and ADR 0005. Every outcome logged through this schema must be independently re-derivable from (state, action, exogenous_input, seed) alone. These contracts are an EvolZen design choice and remain empirically untested until Phase 1.1 experiments are run.

Phase 1.2 — Unified Agent Profile and Identity Schema.

Defines the persistent social, institutional, and lineage identity contracts for agents in the EvolZen multi-agent population (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2, docs/phases/1.2-agents.md, ADR 0006, ADR 0008). Replaces the legacy five-coordinate DriveVector with a rich social profile linked to evolzen.schemas.world.WorldAgentState and the eight-coordinate developmental core (evolzen.schemas.development.AgentDevelopmentState).

Citations: - Park et al. (Generative Agents, arXiv:2304.03442) for agent social identity, memory, and roles; - Cook et al. (Artificial Generational Intelligence, arXiv:2406.00392) for cultural transfer; - Vassiliades et al. (CVT-MAP-Elites, IEEE TEVC 2018, DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2017.2735550) for behavioral descriptor keys in high-dimensional phenotype archives.

These contracts are an EvolZen specification choice and remain empirically untested until Phase 1.2 population experiments are run.

The falsifiable manual schema (Phase 1.3 / Phase 2.3).

Modeled on a 2026 result (Agno) showing this mechanism requires no gradient step, is directly inspectable, and produced a measured capability gain when a cheap model consumed a frontier model's manual rather than re-deriving the same knowledge. Written and revised in evolzen.economy.manuals; consumed as a fast, cheap memory tier in evolzen.recognition, sitting above the frozen evolzen.library and the JEPA + wake-sleep recognition model.

Citations
  • Model collapse & provenance floor: Shumailov et al. (Nature 2024, DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07566-y).
  • Inspectable manual transfer: Agno (2026, agno2026manual).

Phase 1.2 developmental-agent contracts.

The eight-drive ontology and equations are untested EvolZen design choices, not a psychological model. Cultural transfer is motivated by Cook et al. (arXiv:2406.00392); these records do not imply replication of that work.

Phase 1.1 persistent world, growth-ledger, snapshot, and invariant contracts.

Implements the shared cross-subsystem data contracts specified in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4, docs/phases/1.1-environment.md, ADR 0004 (six versioned entity families and bounded extensibility), and ADR 0005 (transition semantics and dual-track evaluation), informed by Tycho (arXiv:2607.28287). These contracts are an EvolZen specification choice and remain empirically untested until Phase 1.1 experiments are run.

Phase 1.1 / Phase 1.5 — Transition log and world-state storage.

DuckDB-backed by default: embedded, zero-ops, schema-versioned, JSON-only (no pickle), and hash-chained for integrity checks. Swap TransitionLogStore for a different backend without changing callers that depend on append / count or the snapshot/growth methods.

Design authority: docs/phases/1.1-environment.md, ADR 0004 (docs/adr/0004-persistent-growing-world.md), and ADR 0005 (docs/adr/0005-transition-semantics-and-dual-track-evaluation.md). Citations: Tycho (arXiv:2607.28287) for complete transition logging enabling active environment identification. Multi-run rig-scale persistence throughput and long-horizon retention remain empirically untested until Phase 1.1 experiments are run.

def load_settings(settings_cls: type[_SettingsT] = EvolZenSettings, yaml_path: Path | None = None) -> _SettingsT:  # type: ignore[assignment]
    """Construct settings, layering a YAML file under environment-variable overrides.

    Args:
        settings_cls: defaults to `EvolZenSettings`; a specific subsystem group can be passed
            for isolated construction in tests.
        yaml_path: path to a YAML file (e.g. ``configs/agents.yaml``). If ``None`` or the file
            doesn't exist, this is equivalent to ``settings_cls()``.
    """
    yaml_overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if yaml_path is not None and yaml_path.exists():
        loaded = yaml.safe_load(yaml_path.read_text())
        if loaded:
            yaml_overrides = loaded
    return settings_cls(**yaml_overrides)

def configure_logging(*, level: str = "INFO", phase: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Configure the shared loguru logger.

    Args:
        level: standard logging level name.
        phase: optional phase tag (e.g. ``"1.4"``) bound into every log line from this
            process, so logs from a multi-phase run can be filtered by phase.
    """
    global _CONFIGURED
    if _CONFIGURED:
        return
    logger.remove()
    fmt = "<green>{time:HH:mm:ss}</green> | <level>{level: <8}</level> | "
    if phase:
        fmt += f"<cyan>phase={phase}</cyan> | "
    fmt += "<level>{message}</level>"
    logger.add(sys.stderr, level=level, format=fmt, colorize=True)
    _CONFIGURED = True

class WandbTracker:
    """Weights & Biases-backed tracker. Requires the `evolzen[tracking]` optional extra.

    Import of `wandb` is deferred to `__init__` so importing this module never requires the
    extra — only *constructing* a `WandbTracker` does.
    """

    def __init__(self, project: str, run_name: str | None = None) -> None:
        try:
            import wandb
        except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - exercised only without the extra
            raise ImportError(
                "WandbTracker requires the 'tracking' extra: uv sync --extra tracking"
            ) from exc
        self._run: Any = wandb.init(project=project, name=run_name)

    def log(self, metrics: dict[str, float], *, step: int | None = None) -> None:
        self._run.log(metrics, step=step)

    def log_params(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._run.config.update(params)

    def finish(self) -> None:
        self._run.finish()

class Manual(BaseModel):
    """A situation-scoped, actively-revised collection of manual entries."""

    situation_key: str = Field(description="Identifies which situation/environment this manual covers.")
    entries: list[ManualEntry] = Field(default_factory=list)

    def add_entry(self, entry: ManualEntry) -> None:
        self.entries.append(entry)

    def active_beliefs(self) -> list[ManualEntry]:
        """Entries not yet falsified — what an agent reading this manual should currently believe."""
        return [e for e in self.entries if e.status != ManualEntryStatus.FALSIFIED]

    def get_entry(self, index: int) -> ManualEntry:
        """Retrieve entry by 0-based index."""
        if not 0 <= index < len(self.entries):
            raise IndexError(f"Manual entry index {index} out of range [0, {len(self.entries) - 1}]")
        return self.entries[index]

    def falsify_entry(self, index: int, evidence_id: str | None = None) -> ManualEntry:
        """Mark an entry as FALSIFIED with optional empirical evidence."""
        old = self.get_entry(index)
        ev = (*old.evidence_ids, evidence_id) if evidence_id else old.evidence_ids
        updated = old.model_copy(update={"status": ManualEntryStatus.FALSIFIED, "evidence_ids": ev})
        self.entries[index] = updated
        return updated

    def revise_entry(
        self,
        index: int,
        new_text: str,
        written_by: str,
        evidence_id: str | None = None,
        provenance: ProvenanceRecord | None = None,
        category: ProvenanceCategory | None = None,
    ) -> ManualEntry:
        """Falsify the old entry and append an active revised entry pointing to the old one."""
        self.falsify_entry(index, evidence_id=evidence_id)
        old_text = self.entries[index].text
        ev = (evidence_id,) if evidence_id else ()
        cat = category if category is not None else (
            provenance.category if provenance is not None else ProvenanceCategory.MODEL_GENERATED
        )
        revised = ManualEntry(
            text=new_text,
            status=ManualEntryStatus.HYPOTHESIS,
            written_by=written_by,
            revised_from=old_text,
            evidence_ids=ev,
            category=cat,
            provenance=provenance,
        )
        self.add_entry(revised)
        return revised

    def confirm_entry(self, index: int, evidence_id: str | None = None) -> ManualEntry:
        """Promote an entry from HYPOTHESIS to CONFIRMED."""
        old = self.get_entry(index)
        ev = (*old.evidence_ids, evidence_id) if evidence_id else old.evidence_ids
        updated = old.model_copy(update={"status": ManualEntryStatus.CONFIRMED, "evidence_ids": ev})
        self.entries[index] = updated
        return updated

    def real_data_fraction(self) -> float:
        """Calculate the proportion of entries sourced from non-model-generated material.

        Returns:
            Fraction in [0.0, 1.0]. Returns 1.0 if manual has no entries.
        """
        if not self.entries:
            return 1.0
        real_count = sum(1 for e in self.entries if e.is_ground_truth)
        return float(real_count / len(self.entries))

def revise_entry(
    self,
    index: int,
    new_text: str,
    written_by: str,
    evidence_id: str | None = None,
    provenance: ProvenanceRecord | None = None,
    category: ProvenanceCategory | None = None,
) -> ManualEntry:
    """Falsify the old entry and append an active revised entry pointing to the old one."""
    self.falsify_entry(index, evidence_id=evidence_id)
    old_text = self.entries[index].text
    ev = (evidence_id,) if evidence_id else ()
    cat = category if category is not None else (
        provenance.category if provenance is not None else ProvenanceCategory.MODEL_GENERATED
    )
    revised = ManualEntry(
        text=new_text,
        status=ManualEntryStatus.HYPOTHESIS,
        written_by=written_by,
        revised_from=old_text,
        evidence_ids=ev,
        category=cat,
        provenance=provenance,
    )
    self.add_entry(revised)
    return revised

class ProvenanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """Immutable provenance record tracking origin, verification, and deterministic digest.

    Attributes:
        provenance_id: Unique identifier for this provenance record.
        category: Origin category classifying whether data is human, simulation, or model.
        uri_or_source: URI, path, or origin identifier (dataset URL, simulator seed, etc.).
        description: Human-readable description of the origin material.
        created_tick: Simulation clock tick at which the provenance record was registered.
        sampling_weight: Normalized sampling weight in [0.0, 1.0].
        hash_digest: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the canonical metadata or content.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", validate_default=True)

    provenance_id: str
    category: ProvenanceCategory
    uri_or_source: str
    description: str = ""
    created_tick: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    sampling_weight: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    hash_digest: str = ""

    @property
    def is_ground_truth(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if category is human-authored, demonstration, or simulator trace."""
        return self.category in GROUND_TRUTH_CATEGORIES

    def compute_digest(self, content: str | bytes | None = None) -> str:
        """Compute deterministic SHA-256 hex digest of source content or canonical metadata."""
        if content is not None:
            payload = content.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content, str) else content
            return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        canonical = {
            "category": str(self.category),
            "created_tick": self.created_tick,
            "description": self.description,
            "provenance_id": self.provenance_id,
            "sampling_weight": self.sampling_weight,
            "uri_or_source": self.uri_or_source,
        }
        encoded = json.dumps(canonical, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
        return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()

    def with_computed_digest(self) -> ProvenanceRecord:
        """Return an immutable copy of this record with hash_digest populated."""
        return self.model_copy(update={"hash_digest": self.compute_digest()})

    @classmethod
    def create(
        cls,
        *,
        provenance_id: str,
        category: ProvenanceCategory,
        uri_or_source: str,
        description: str = "",
        created_tick: int = 0,
        sampling_weight: float = 1.0,
        hash_digest: str | None = None,
    ) -> ProvenanceRecord:
        """Factory creating a ProvenanceRecord, computing deterministic digest if hash_digest is None."""
        rec = cls(
            provenance_id=provenance_id,
            category=category,
            uri_or_source=uri_or_source,
            description=description,
            created_tick=created_tick,
            sampling_weight=sampling_weight,
            hash_digest=hash_digest if hash_digest is not None else "",
        )
        if hash_digest is None:
            rec = rec.with_computed_digest()
        return rec

    @classmethod
    def compute_content_digest(cls, content: str | bytes | dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Compute deterministic SHA-256 hex digest for arbitrary content."""
        if isinstance(content, dict):
            payload = json.dumps(content, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
        elif isinstance(content, str):
            payload = content.encode("utf-8")
        else:
            payload = content
        return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

class BrainSnapshot(Record):
    """Serializable in-memory state; persistent event storage remains an integration task."""

    birth: BirthRecord
    config: DevelopmentConfig = DevelopmentConfig()
    tick: Tick
    sequence: Tick = 0
    activation: Signal = ZERO
    knowledge: tuple[SkillEstimate, ...] = ()
    lessons: tuple[Lesson, ...] = ()
    recent: tuple[Outcome, ...] = ()
    pending: Decision | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def consistent_snapshot(self) -> Self:
        """Validate restoration boundaries; authenticity still belongs to the host."""
        if self.tick < self.birth.born_at:
            raise ValueError("Clock predates birth")
        if len(self.knowledge) > self.config.knowledge_limit:
            raise ValueError("Knowledge budget exceeded")
        if len(self.lessons) > self.config.lesson_limit or len(self.recent) > self.config.memory_limit:
            raise ValueError("Memory budget exceeded")
        keys = [(item.context_key, item.skill_key) for item in self.knowledge]
        if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate knowledge keys")
        if self.pending is not None and (
            self.pending.agent_id != self.birth.agent_id
            or self.pending.sequence != self.sequence
            or self.pending.tick != self.tick
            or self.pending.activation != self.activation
        ):
            raise ValueError("Pending decision does not match snapshot")
        for item in self.recent:
            if (item.agent_id != self.birth.agent_id or not item.verified
                    or item.tick > self.tick or item.sequence > self.sequence):
                raise ValueError("Invalid outcome history")
        for lesson in self.lessons:
            if (lesson.learner_id != self.birth.agent_id
                    or lesson.teacher_id not in self.birth.parents
                    or not self.birth.born_at <= lesson.taught_at <= self.tick):
                raise ValueError("Invalid lesson history")
        return self

class WorldState(WorldRecord):
    """Complete deterministic world state covering all six ADR 0004 entity families."""

    world_version: str = "world-v1"
    feature_schema_version: str = "features-v1"
    run_id: Identifier = "default-run"
    branch_id: Identifier = "main"
    tick: NonNegInt = 0
    step_index: NonNegInt = 0
    seed: int = 0
    max_ticks: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] = 2000
    max_agents: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] = 64
    lifespan: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] = 1500
    adulthood_age: NonNegInt = 300
    locations: dict[str, LocationNode] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    agents: dict[str, WorldAgentState] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    artifacts: dict[str, ArtifactRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    capabilities: dict[str, CapabilityPackage] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    contracts: dict[str, ContractRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    institutions: dict[str, InstitutionRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    norms: dict[str, NormRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    accounting: ResourceAccounting = Field(default_factory=ResourceAccounting)

    def canonical_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a deterministically ordered JSON-serializable dictionary."""
        raw = self.model_dump(mode="json")
        return json.loads(canonical_json(raw))  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

    def state_hash(self) -> str:
        """Compute deterministic SHA-256 hash of the complete canonical state."""
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(self.canonical_dict()).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def to_state(self) -> State:
        """Convert to a `evolzen.schemas.transition.State` with deterministic `state_id`."""
        data = self.canonical_dict()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(data).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return State(state_id=uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, f"evolzen:state:{digest}"), data=data)

    @classmethod
    def from_state(cls, state: State) -> WorldState:
        """Reconstruct a validated `WorldState` from a `State` envelope."""
        return cls.model_validate(state.data)

docs.title: TransitionLogStore
docs.text:
Append-only DuckDB store for transitions, snapshots, growth events, and branches.

Every record is serialized strictly as JSON (never pickle). Appends run inside explicit DuckDB transactions and extend a per-store SHA-256 hash chain.

Source code in src/evolzen/storage/transition_log.py 
class TransitionLogStore:
    """Append-only DuckDB store for transitions, snapshots, growth events, and branches.

    Every record is serialized strictly as JSON (never pickle). Appends run inside
    explicit DuckDB transactions and extend a per-store SHA-256 hash chain.
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path: Path) -> None:
        self._db_path = db_path
        self._db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._conn: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection = duckdb.connect(str(self._db_path))
        self._init_schema()

    def _init_schema(self) -> None:
        self._conn.execute("BEGIN TRANSACTION")
        try:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (
                    schema_version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transitions (
                    seq_no BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    transition_id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
                    run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    branch_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    tick BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    seed BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    state_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    action_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    exogenous_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    emission_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    next_state_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    prev_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    entry_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (
                    snapshot_id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
                    run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    branch_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    tick BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    parent_snapshot_id VARCHAR,
                    world_version VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    snapshot_json VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    snapshot_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS growth_events (
                    seq_no BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    event_id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
                    run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    branch_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    tick BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    category VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    attribution VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    actor_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    entity_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    summary VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    transition_id VARCHAR NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS branches (
                    branch_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    parent_branch_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    fork_tick BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    fork_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, branch_id)
                )
                """
            )
            existing_version = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT schema_version FROM schema_meta WHERE schema_version = ?",
                [SCHEMA_VERSION],
            ).fetchone()
            if existing_version is None:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO schema_meta (schema_version, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    [SCHEMA_VERSION, datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)],
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the underlying DuckDB connection."""
        self._conn.close()

    def __enter__(self) -> TransitionLogStore:
        return self

    def __exit__(
        self,
        exc_type: type[BaseException] | None,
        exc_val: BaseException | None,
        exc_tb: TracebackType | None,
    ) -> None:
        self.close()

    def schema_version(self) -> int:
        """Return the active persisted schema version."""
        row = self._conn.execute("SELECT MAX(schema_version) FROM schema_meta").fetchone()
        return int(row[0]) if row and row[0] is not None else 0

    def append(
        self,
        transition: Transition,
        *,
        run_id: str | None = None,
        branch_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Persist one transition atomically with hash-chain linkage."""
        resolved_run = run_id or str(transition.state.data.get("run_id", "default-run"))
        resolved_branch = branch_id or str(transition.state.data.get("branch_id", "main"))
        tick = int(transition.state.data.get("tick", transition.exogenous_input.tick))
        state_json = transition.state.model_dump_json()
        action_json = transition.action.model_dump_json()
        exogenous_json = transition.exogenous_input.model_dump_json()
        emission_json = transition.emission.model_dump_json()
        next_state_json = transition.next_state.model_dump_json()
        transition_id = str(transition.transition_id)
        ts = transition.timestamp.astimezone(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)

        self._conn.execute("BEGIN TRANSACTION")
        try:
            last = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT seq_no, entry_hash FROM transitions ORDER BY seq_no DESC LIMIT 1"
            ).fetchone()
            seq_no = int(last[0]) + 1 if last is not None else 1
            prev_hash = str(last[1]) if last is not None else _GENESIS_HASH
            entry_hash = _transition_digest(
                prev_hash,
                transition_id,
                resolved_run,
                resolved_branch,
                tick,
                transition.seed,
                state_json,
                action_json,
                exogenous_json,
                emission_json,
                next_state_json,
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO transitions (
                    seq_no, transition_id, run_id, branch_id, tick, timestamp, seed,
                    state_json, action_json, exogenous_json, emission_json, next_state_json,
                    prev_hash, entry_hash
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                [
                    seq_no,
                    transition_id,
                    resolved_run,
                    resolved_branch,
                    tick,
                    ts,
                    transition.seed,
                    state_json,
                    action_json,
                    exogenous_json,
                    emission_json,
                    next_state_json,
                    prev_hash,
                    entry_hash,
                ],
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def count(self, *, run_id: str | None = None, branch_id: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Number of transitions currently stored, optionally filtered by run/branch."""
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if run_id is not None:
            clauses.append("run_id = ?")
            params.append(run_id)
        if branch_id is not None:
            clauses.append("branch_id = ?")
            params.append(branch_id)
        where = f" WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        row = self._conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transitions{where}", params).fetchone()
        return int(row[0]) if row is not None else 0

    def list_transitions(
        self,
        *,
        run_id: str | None = None,
        branch_id: str | None = None,
        from_tick: int | None = None,
        to_tick: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[Transition]:
        """Load transitions in append order, optionally filtered by run/branch/ticks."""
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if run_id is not None:
            clauses.append("run_id = ?")
            params.append(run_id)
        if branch_id is not None:
            clauses.append("branch_id = ?")
            params.append(branch_id)
        if from_tick is not None:
            clauses.append("tick >= ?")
            params.append(from_tick)
        if to_tick is not None:
            clauses.append("tick <= ?")
            params.append(to_tick)
        where = f" WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT transition_id, timestamp, seed, state_json, action_json,
                   exogenous_json, emission_json, next_state_json
            FROM transitions{where}
            ORDER BY seq_no ASC
            """,
            params,
        ).fetchall()
        results: list[Transition] = []
        for row in rows:
            ts_val = row[1]
            if isinstance(ts_val, datetime) and ts_val.tzinfo is None:
                ts_val = ts_val.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
            results.append(
                Transition(
                    transition_id=row[0],
                    timestamp=ts_val,
                    seed=int(row[2]),
                    state=State.model_validate_json(row[3]),
                    action=Action.model_validate_json(row[4]),
                    exogenous_input=ExogenousInput.model_validate_json(row[5]),
                    emission=Emission.model_validate_json(row[6]),
                    next_state=State.model_validate_json(row[7]),
                )
            )
        return results

    def verify_integrity(self) -> bool:
        """Verify the SHA-256 hash chain across all persisted transitions."""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT seq_no, transition_id, run_id, branch_id, tick, seed,
                   state_json, action_json, exogenous_json, emission_json, next_state_json,
                   prev_hash, entry_hash
            FROM transitions
            ORDER BY seq_no ASC
            """
        ).fetchall()
        expected_prev = _GENESIS_HASH
        for row in rows:
            if row[11] != expected_prev:
                return False
            recomputed = _transition_digest(
                str(row[11]),
                str(row[1]),
                str(row[2]),
                str(row[3]),
                int(row[4]),
                int(row[5]),
                str(row[6]),
                str(row[7]),
                str(row[8]),
                str(row[9]),
                str(row[10]),
            )
            if recomputed != row[12]:
                return False
            expected_prev = str(row[12])
        return True

    def _insert_snapshot(self, snapshot: WorldSnapshot) -> None:
        payload = snapshot.model_dump_json()
        self._conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO snapshots (
                snapshot_id, run_id, branch_id, tick, parent_snapshot_id,
                world_version, snapshot_json, snapshot_hash, created_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            [
                snapshot.snapshot_id,
                snapshot.run_id,
                snapshot.branch_id,
                snapshot.tick,
                snapshot.parent_snapshot_id,
                snapshot.world_version,
                payload,
                snapshot.state_hash,
                datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None),
            ],
        )

    def _insert_branch(self, branch: BranchRecord) -> None:
        self._conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO branches (
                branch_id, run_id, parent_branch_id, fork_tick, fork_snapshot_id, created_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            [
                branch.branch_id,
                branch.run_id,
                branch.parent_branch_id,
                branch.fork_tick,
                branch.fork_snapshot_id,
                datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None),
            ],
        )

    def save_snapshot(self, snapshot: WorldSnapshot) -> None:
        """Persist an immutable `WorldSnapshot` record atomically."""

def append(
    self,
    transition: Transition,
    *,
    run_id: str | None = None,
    branch_id: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Persist one transition atomically with hash-chain linkage."""
    resolved_run = run_id or str(transition.state.data.get("run_id", "default-run"))
    resolved_branch = branch_id or str(transition.state.data.get("branch_id", "main"))
    tick = int(transition.state.data.get("tick", transition.exogenous_input.tick))
    state_json = transition.state.model_dump_json()
    action_json = transition.action.model_dump_json()
    exogenous_json = transition.exogenous_input.model_dump_json()
    emission_json = transition.emission.model_dump_json()
    next_state_json = transition.next_state.model_dump_json()
    transition_id = str(transition.transition_id)
    ts = transition.timestamp.astimezone(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)

    self._conn.execute("BEGIN TRANSACTION")
    try:
        last = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT seq_no, entry_hash FROM transitions ORDER BY seq_no DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        seq_no = int(last[0]) + 1 if last is not None else 1
        prev_hash = str(last[1]) if last is not None else _GENESIS_HASH
        entry_hash = _transition_digest(
            prev_hash,
            transition_id,
            resolved_run,
            resolved_branch,
            tick,
            transition.seed,
            state_json,
            action_json,
            exogenous_json,
            emission_json,
            next_state_json,
        )
        self._conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO transitions (
                seq_no, transition_id, run_id, branch_id, tick, timestamp, seed,
                state_json, action_json, exogenous_json, emission_json, next_state_json,
                prev_hash, entry_hash
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            [
                seq_no,
                transition_id,
                resolved_run,
                resolved_branch,
                tick,
                ts,
                transition.seed,
                state_json,
                action_json,
                exogenous_json,
                emission_json,
                next_state_json,
                prev_hash,
                entry_hash,
            ],
        )
        self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except Exception:
        self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise

def verify_integrity(self) -> bool:
    """Verify the SHA-256 hash chain across all persisted transitions."""
    rows = self._conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT seq_no, transition_id, run_id, branch_id, tick, seed,
               state_json, action_json, exogenous_json, emission_json, next_state_json,
               prev_hash, entry_hash
        FROM transitions
        ORDER BY seq_no ASC
        """
    ).fetchall()
    expected_prev = _GENESIS_HASH
    for row in rows:
        if row[11] != expected_prev:
            return False
        recomputed = _transition_digest(
            str(row[11]),
            str(row[1]),
            str(row[2]),
            str(row[3]),
            int(row[4]),
            int(row[5]),
            str(row[6]),
            str(row[7]),
            str(row[8]),
            str(row[9]),
            str(row[10]),
        )
        if recomputed != row[12]:
            return False
        expected_prev = str(row[12])
    return True

docs.title: API Reference — evolzen.library
docs.text:
The append-only, non-overwriting verified-rule library (Phase 1.5).

Verified rules (that passed evolzen.exploration.verifier.Verifier) become frozen :class:~evolzen.schemas.library.RuleEntry instances stored here. A new entry is spawned only when no existing active rule is sufficiently similar to the candidate — the same "does this fit anything I already have?" logic as a Dirichlet process mixture model (Ferguson, 1973). Existing entries are never overwritten; the Phase 1.5 success metric is exactly zero forgetting on a held-out regression bank across repeated additions (untested until CI runs).

Default routing uses difflib.SequenceMatcher on code text — a stdlib-only, dependency-free baseline. Callers may supply a custom routing_confidence_fn for embedding-based or AST-based similarity.

Phase 1.5 — evolzen.library. Reference: docs/phases/1.5-library.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5, PRD FR-6, Ferguson (1973) "A Bayesian Analysis of Some Nonparametric Problems".

DuckDB-backed append-only persistence layer for the Phase 1.5 rule library.

All writes are append-only: no row is ever physically overwritten or deleted. Status updates and supersession links are recorded as new rows; the retrieval methods return the most-recent state per rule_id via a window function.

Phase 1.5 — evolzen.library. Reference: docs/phases/1.5-library.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5, PRD FR-6. Persistence pattern adapted from evolzen.storage.transition_log (DuckDB context- manager-per-call convention).

Validity-context helpers for the Phase 1.5 rule library.

A rule is applicable in a given context when its recorded :class:~evolzen.schemas.library.ValidityContext is compatible with the context being queried. Compatibility is defined as:

  • world_version must match exactly.
  • mechanic_keys sets must share at least one element.
  • seed_range intervals must overlap (inclusive).

Phase 1.5 — evolzen.library. Reference: docs/phases/1.5-library.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5.

Append-only JSONL audit log for the Phase 1.5 rule library.

One :class:AuditEvent is written per state-changing library operation. The log is append-only: events are never modified or deleted. Reading the log is always safe from multiple processes (file-level read; writes use an exclusive file lock via fcntl on POSIX and msvcrt on Windows).

Phase 1.5 — evolzen.library. Reference: docs/phases/1.5-library.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5.

Held-out regression bank for the Phase 1.5 zero-forgetting success metric.

The bank stores serialisable transition fixtures (plain dicts, not executable code) keyed by rule_id. When :meth:RegressionBank.check_rule is called, it replays each fixture against the rule's declared explains predicates and compares the stored expected emission to the actual one.

Pydantic schemas for the Phase 1.5 verified-rule library (evolzen.library).

Every type here is frozen — instances are immutable after construction. No field may be silently coerced or added beyond the declared schema (extra="forbid"). Any downstream consumer that changes these schemas must re-run mypy --strict across all nine subsystems before merging.

Phase 1.5 — evolzen.library. Reference: docs/phases/1.5-library.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5, PRD FR-6.
