docs.title: Comparative Landscape (reviewed 2026-10-21)
docs.text: docs/research/literature-review.md gives the six-thread summary mapped to subsystems. This document is the fuller picture behind it — the source-status notes, dated benchmark context, and reasoning that shaped the major design decisions in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, kept in one place so claims do not have to be re-derived per subsystem.

docs.title: The field's own yardstick
docs.text: ARC-AGI-3 is relevant because it operationalizes one important question: how efficiently can a system learn an unfamiliar interactive task under a fixed action/observation protocol. It is not a universal definition of general intelligence and its leaderboard is date-sensitive. The official ARC material distinguishes public progress from blind evaluation; third-party leaderboard summaries should not be used as permanent baselines. EvolZen records the benchmark date and source when it cites ARC-AGI-3, and uses its own EAE metric for a custom world unless the official protocol is followed exactly [arcprize2026].

docs.title: The public-set/private-set gap — the single most load-bearing fact in this design
docs.text:
A different, important pattern remains: specialized agent harnesses and persistent manuals can substantially improve performance on a reused public set. That is an exposure-regime result, not automatically evidence of cold-start generalization. Vendor or third-party reports are retained as case studies, labeled as such, and are not treated as independent replication [agno2026manual].

Read this as a methodological warning: reused-set performance and fresh-set performance answer different questions. The exact gap is not a permanent constant and must be re-measured for each system, exposure protocol, model, and benchmark release.

This is why evolzen.evaluation.procedural_env_gen exists at all, and why it's a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: evolzen.evaluation's held-out testing must be designed so it can't quietly collapse into measuring the first thing while believing it measures the second. See docs/phases/2.4-2.5-evaluation.md and evolzen.evaluation.report.EvaluationReport, which makes the reused-vs-fresh gap a required field, not optional.

docs.title: Programmatic world-model synthesis
docs.text:
Several recent approaches use actor/synthesizer/verifier systems that build an executable world model from interaction and check it against replay:

  • OPINE-World (Courtis, Li & Sanner, opineworld2026, arXiv:2607.01531): pairs a qualitative object-oriented natural-language proto-ontology with an executable Python world model and Bayesian uncertainty exploration.
  • Tycho (Lehmann, Aioanei & Vahdati, tycho2026, arXiv:2607.28287): formalizes tasks as parameterized deterministic transition systems and uses active abstraction to decide when to construct, test, repair, or bypass executable hypotheses.
  • Executable World Models (Rodionov, executableworldmodels2026, arXiv:2605.05138): maintains replay-verified Python world models refactored under a Minimum Description Length simplicity bias before action planning.

These are relevant design precedents, not proof that the method transfers automatically to a persistent social sandbox. EvolZen may use an existing coding-agent harness as a candidate synthesizer, but all generated code remains behind containment and transfer is tested explicitly.

docs.title: Representation learning and library learning
docs.text:
• LeJEPA (Balestriero & LeCun, lejepa2025, arXiv:2511.08544) and When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model? (lejepaworldmodel2026, arXiv:2605.26379) replace ad-hoc stop-gradient or teacher-student heuristics with Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg), building on I-JEPA (assran2023ijepa, CVPR 2023).
  • DreamCoder (dreamcoder2021, PLDI 2021) and Wake-Sleep Event Semantics (Balogh, wakesleepschank2026, arXiv:2603.25975) demonstrate wake-sleep operator compression over state transformations, while FAISS (johnson2019faiss, IEEE TBDATA 2019) supports sparse vector retrieval over evolzen.library.

The proposed EvolZen combination is not assumed to be necessary, novel, or effective: it must be compared against simpler state encoders, symbolic baselines, and manual-only conditions.

docs.title: Continual learning remains an open engineering risk
docs.text: Continual learning remains an empirical risk rather than a solved property (IEEE TPAMI survey, wang2024continualsurvey). CLEAR (rolnick2019clear, NeurIPS 2019) motivates mixing off-policy replay with on-policy updates; TFGN (Ganguli, tfgn2026, arXiv:2605.15053) explores task-free replay-free continual pretraining; and CLaaS (Fallah et al., claas2026, arXiv:2606.05559) investigates online continual adaptation services. Reported numbers are not imported as universal baselines for EvolZen; the predictor phase must measure forgetting, spurious forgetting, forward/backward transfer, adaptation latency, and update cost directly.

docs.title: Recent agent-evolution and economic precedents
docs.text:
• DGM (dgm2026, ICLR 2026), Hyperagents (Zhang et al., hyperagents2026, arXiv:2603.19461), and CORAL (Qu et al., coral2026, arXiv:2604.01658) demonstrate archive-gated empirical self-modification, metacognitive meta-agent editing (DGM-H), and persistent-memory asynchronous multi-agent evolution.
  • Economy of Minds (Qi et al., economyofminds2026, arXiv:2606.02859) and The AI Economist (zheng2022aieconomist, Science Advances 2022) motivate market auctions, wealth feedback, and specialization rules without centralized scripting.

They do not establish that small local LLM agents with drive vectors will evolve useful social types or grow a persistent world; EvolZen treats those transfers as hypotheses requiring matched ablations.

docs.title: Diversity collapse is a testable population risk
docs.text: Chen et al. (diversitycollapse2026, ACL 2026 Findings, arXiv:2604.18005) identify how structural coupling, dense communication topologies, and authority-driven hierarchy create "semantic black holes" that collapse idea diversity in multi-agent LLM populations. EvolZen treats those mechanisms as testable hypotheses alongside CVT-MAP-Elites (vassiliades2018cvtmape, IEEE TEVC 2018) and limited-resource QD (qdlimited2024, ICML 2024).

docs.title: Containment has moved past cgroup/eBPF
docs.text: Systems and agent-security literature — Firecracker KVM microVMs (agache2020firecracker, USENIX NSDI 2020), Safety Must Precede Open-Ended AI (Sheth et al., safetyopenended2025, arXiv:2502.04512), and Beyond Static Sandboxing (Sidik & Rokach, sidikrokach2026, arXiv:2604.11839, documenting ~15× tool overprovisioning in default runtimes and ~73% tool reduction via PPO least-privilege capability scoping) — motivates hardware isolation, continuous runtime evaluation, and fail-closed default-deny governance. The selected deployment backend must still pass a target-host threat model before generated code runs outside tests.

docs.title: Full reference list
docs.text: See references.bib.

docs.title: Literature Review — Six Research Threads
docs.text:
Six research threads this design draws on. The project combines precedents from peer-reviewed work, preprints, and vendor reports; the source status is recorded in references.bib. The project's contribution is a measured combination, not an assumption that any one thread solves the whole problem.

  1. World Models, Standardized Environments & Evaluation Splits — executable state-transition models (opineworld2026, tycho2026), standardized multi-agent transition APIs (PettingZoo, Terry et al., NeurIPS 2021, terry2021pettingzoo), and procedural OOD evaluation splits (Procgen, Cobbe et al., ICML 2020, cobbe2020procgen; ARC-AGI-2, Chollet et al., chollet2025arcagi2) motivate evolzen.environment and evolzen.evaluation; they do not by themselves establish causal identification or AGI claims.
  2. Continual Learning — forgetting and spurious forgetting depend on the task sequence and update regime (Wang et al., IEEE TPAMI 2024, wang2024continualsurvey). Motivates replay, dynamic-capacity isolation, rollback, and explicit transfer metrics in library and predictor.
  3. Verified World-Model Synthesis & Skill Libraries — actor/synthesizer/verifier loops (OPINE-World, Tycho, and executable skill-library agents such as Voyager, TMLR 2023, wang2023voyager) are relevant precedents for bounded exploration (evolzen.exploration) and append-only rule retention (evolzen.library).
  4. Program-Synthesis Memory — DreamCoder's wake/sleep bootstrapping is a component precedent for evolzen.recognition.wake_sleep, not evidence that a JEPA fusion will work here.
  5. Population Diversity & Intrinsic Motivation — quality-diversity (Pugh et al. 2016; CVT-MAP-Elites, IEEE TEVC 2018, vassiliades2018cvtmape; ICML 2024 qdlimited2024) and intrinsically motivated developmental learning (IEEE TEVC 2007 oudeyer2007intrinsic; IEEE TCDS 2016 santucci2016grail) motivate explicit behavioral descriptors, sparse communication, and collapse monitoring in evolzen.agents. Open-ended environment/agent proposals (OMNI-EPIC faldor2024omniepic; Hyperagents hyperagents2026; Hughes et al. ICML 2024 hughes2024openended) motivate bounded diversity metrics without relaxing PRD.md §4 non-goals.
  6. Data Provenance, Economic Mechanisms & Hardware Containment — recursive training on prior generations' own output reduces diversity and rare-behavior coverage (Shumailov et al., Nature 2024, shumailov2024collapse), while two-level economic RL (Zheng et al., Science Advances 2022, zheng2022aieconomist) informs multi-agent incentive/taxation dynamics in evolzen.economy. On the systems boundary, KVM microVM virtualization (Firecracker, Agache et al., USENIX NSDI 2020, agache2020firecracker) and default-deny capability governance (sidikrokach2026) ground evolzen.containment.Sandbox.

docs.title: Research Objectives & Evaluation Standard
docs.text: Status: Phase 0 scaffolding is complete and code baselines exist for Phase 1.1 (evolzen.environment, schemas/world.py, TransitionLogStore), Phase 1.2-numerical (agents/development/), and Phase 1.5 (evolzen.library); no empirical result is claimed yet. Scope: defines what EvolZen is trying to learn, what counts as evidence, and which comparisons must be completed before a paper claim is written.

docs.title: 1. Target definition
docs.text:
EvolZen does not target AGI, emotional intelligence, real-human psychology, or universal laws of civilization. Its target is a bounded, testable system with two separable capabilities:

  1. Persistent world growth: a seeded social sandbox changes durably through declared world processes and agent actions, producing attributable artifacts, capabilities, institutions, norms, markets, roles, and lineages without evaluator-injected milestones.
  2. Efficient adaptation: a predictor/recognition system adapts to held-out world seeds and mechanic combinations with fewer costly exploratory actions than declared baselines.

World growth is not evidence of learning generality, and fresh-world adaptation is not evidence that the world itself is socially realistic. Both must be measured separately.

docs.title: 2. Research questions
docs.text: The original developmental-agent question is specified in agent evaluation: do birth-time eight-drive equations, age/context modulation, personal learning and living-parent teaching produce useful adaptation or cultural accumulation beyond matched simpler controls? The new local code is a numerical baseline, not evidence of neural self-training. The detailed page supplies a proposed EAE formula, pilot budget, split rules, uncertainty unit and implementation gates.

docs.title: RQ1 — Can the world grow independently?
docs.text: Under a fixed transition contract, can the population produce durable world changes beyond a fixed scripted baseline, while preserving replayability, resource/institution invariants, and recovery after declared shocks?

docs.title: RQ2 — Does behavioral diversity matter?
docs.text: Does a typed heterogeneous population with QD selection produce more persistent specialization, lineage diversity, and world-growth coverage than a matched homogeneous or fitness-only population?

docs.title: RQ3 — Does verified exploration improve discovery?
docs.text: Does actor/synthesizer/verifier exploration improve held-out transition and intervention performance relative to passive exploration or a no-synthesis baseline, without increasing false promotions?

docs.title: RQ4 — Does the learning system improve adaptation?
docs.text: Do predictor and recognition components reduce adaptation latency or exploratory action cost on fresh world seeds and held-out mechanic combinations compared with library-only, manual-only, and recognition-disabled baselines?

docs.title: RQ5 — Does continual learning retain capability?
docs.text: Under a declared update and replay budget, how do rehearsal, task-free training, and other ablations affect backward transfer, forward transfer, spurious forgetting, true forgetting, and update cost?

docs.title: RQ6 — Is execution controlled?
docs.text: Can the containment boundary demonstrate fail-closed capability control, bounded resources, complete logging, kill-switch behavior, recovery, and evaluator separation on the target host?

docs.title: 3. Proposed hypotheses (registration pending)
docs.text:
These are hypotheses, not commitments to positive results:

  • H1: the persistent-world condition will produce more durable growth categories than the scripted/no-growth baseline.
  • H2: QD selection and the declared agent ontology will preserve more behavioral/type coverage than fitness-only or homogeneous-population baselines.
  • H3: verified exploration will improve held-out transition/intervention performance at a measurable exploration cost.
  • H4: recognition-enabled systems will reduce fresh-world adaptation latency or action cost in at least one track without unacceptable regression in the persistent-world track.
  • H5: replay/rehearsal will reduce backward degradation relative to matched no-replay updates, subject to its data and compute budget.
  • H6: the containment implementation will satisfy all mandatory invariants before any generated code is allowed into a long-running experiment.

Null and negative results are valid outcomes. No hypothesis is considered supported by an in-sandbox score alone.

docs.title: Track A — Persistent-world growth
docs.text:
Each run starts from a recorded seed and proceeds through a long-horizon event-sourced world. During the scored interval:

  • evaluator writes are disabled except for pre-declared exogenous inputs;
  • every durable change receives a growth-event attribution;
  • snapshots and event logs support independent replay;
  • shocks, recovery windows, and resource budgets are declared before the run; and
  • the run records agent exposure, manuals, replay access, rule versions, and capability promotions.

Primary measurements:

  • growth-event count and category coverage;
  • persistence of artifacts, institutions, norms, roles, and lineages;
  • world-health invariants and recovery time;
  • population/type occupancy, extinction, replacement, specialization, and lineage diversity;
  • resource concentration and collapse indicators; and
  • evaluator-injection violations.

docs.title: Track B — Fresh-world adaptation
docs.text:
The evaluator generates held-out world seeds and held-out combinations of mechanics after training and development decisions are frozen. Final held-out instances are never reused for tuning.

Primary measurements:

  • EvolZen Action Efficiency (EAE);
  • adaptation latency;
  • exploratory action count and cost;
  • success under a fixed action/time budget;
  • intervention response on held-out variables;
  • compute and token cost; and
  • failure, abstention, and recovery behavior.

EAE is an EvolZen metric inspired by the motivation of action-efficiency benchmarks. It is not reported as official ARC-AGI-3 RHAE unless the official task and scoring protocol are followed.

docs.title: 5. Required baselines and ablations
docs.text:
The final evaluation must include, at minimum:

  1. scripted/no-growth world versus endogenous-growth world;
  2. homogeneous population versus typed heterogeneous population;
  3. fitness-only selection versus QD selection;
  4. no-economy/no-institution condition versus economy/institution condition;
  5. passive exploration versus explanation-gap-guided exploration;
  6. no-synthesizer condition versus sandboxed synthesizer/verifier;
  7. library-only, manual-only, recognition-disabled, JEPA-only, wake-sleep-only, and combined recognition conditions;
  8. rehearsal/replay versus matched no-replay continual updates; and
  9. retrieval-assisted versus retrieval-disabled conditions, with all external assistance logged.

Containment is never removed as a convenience ablation. Security tests vary the deliberate violation, not whether the boundary exists.

docs.title: 6. Data and split rules
docs.text:
• Development, validation, and final held-out seeds are generated from disjoint seed registries.
  • Mechanic combinations in the final fresh-world track are not exposed during tuning.
  • Reused-world scores and fresh-world scores are reported separately.
  • Manual access, replay access, retrieval access, rule versions, and exposure count are recorded for every result.
  • Synthetic output is labeled as synthetic. It cannot satisfy an external/provenance floor merely because it was generated by a different model.
  • Human or frontier references receive the same observation, action, information, and time budget.

docs.title: 7. Statistical and reporting standard
docs.text:
Before the final run, record:

  • seed lists or seed-generation versions;
  • baseline definitions and ablation matrix;
  • primary and secondary endpoints;
  • stopping rules and exclusion rules;
  • compute, token, replay, and exposure budgets; and
  • the planned aggregation and uncertainty method.

Report per-seed results, aggregate uncertainty, failures, extinctions, abstentions, and null results. Do not select a headline metric after inspecting which result is largest. A paper claim must point to a measured field in EvaluationReport and to the corresponding run artifacts.

docs.title: 8. Decision gates
docs.text:
Gate Required evidence before proceeding G0 — contract Transition, snapshot, growth-event, agent-profile, provenance, and capability contracts are frozen. G1 — world Replay works; growth is attributable; invariants and shock recovery are measured. G2 — population Capacity envelope and five-generation diversity report exist. G3 — exploration Replay/intervention promotion checks and false-promotion measurements exist. G4 — containment Interface, backend, and target-host acceptance tests pass. G5 — learning Predictor baselines and transfer/forgetting curves exist before JEPA fusion claims. G6 — publication Both evaluation tracks, all required ablations, exposure history, and limitations are reported.

The project plan is not considered complete until G0–G6 are satisfied. As of 2026-11-12 (env @ 81ee6eb), Phase 0 scaffolding is complete and code baselines exist for Phase 1.1 (evolzen.environment, schemas/world.py, TransitionLogStore), Phase 1.2-numerical (agents/development/), and Phase 1.5 (evolzen.library), while remaining G0 items (AgentProfile, ProvenanceRecord, and Phase 1.1 hardening ENV-01–ENV-08) are still open. G1–G6 empirical gates remain unsatisfied, and no empirical result is claimed yet.

docs.title: Subsystem design navigation
docs.text:
One package, nine subsystems. This documentation hierarchy does not create new packages. Requirements live in PRD; cross-system boundaries in Architecture; experiments in research. Subsystem folders hold detailed contracts, rationale and implementation status.

Folder Responsibility Phase authority environment World state, clocks, observations, authoritative outcomes 1.1 agents Birth, eight drives, development, personal learning and teaching 1.2 economy Resource transfers, manuals and provenance 1.3 exploration Proposals, experiments and replay verification 1.4 library Versioned reusable artifacts 1.5 predictor Outcome and intent prediction 2.1 containment Execution permissions and isolation 2.2 recognition Transferable proposal priors 2.3 evaluation Independent measurements and frozen final evaluation 2.4–2.5

Detailed agent documents supersede earlier five-coordinate Phase 0 interface stubs for the active developmental path. Phase 1.1 world and action schemas are now implemented in src/evolzen/schemas/world.py (WorldState, ActionType, CapabilityPackage) and src/evolzen/environment/adapter.py; reconciling or retiring those legacy five-coordinate Phase 0 stubs against the active eight-coordinate developmental core remains an explicit Phase 1.2 action item.

docs.title: Developmental agents: seven sins plus Null
docs.text: Design version: eight-drive-v1, October 24, 2026 (workflow architecture upgraded November 12, 2026). Status: a deterministic numerical baseline is implemented; no experiment has established developmental intelligence, neural self-training, or population evolution.

docs.title: User-visible target
docs.text:
An agent is born as a child with its own randomized equation, acquires experience with age, acts according to changing motivational ratios, learns from outcomes, and can be taught by living parents. On maturation it can contribute temperament to a new child. A child does not receive its parents' learned skills at birth. The world and host—not the agent—control permissions, resource limits, clocks, births and authoritative outcome verification.

The original names are preserved: pride, greed, lust, envy, gluttony, wrath, sloth, Null. These are fictional motivational coordinates, not moral ratings of agents or scientific categories of humans. Lust means nonsexual attraction/affiliation in this implementation, including all child-stage behavior. Reproduction is a population-management operation. Null means no goal-directed engagement: waiting, resting or abstaining. It is not death, depression, self-destruction, or a ninth drive.

docs.title: Read in order
docs.text:
1. Finalized Agentic Behaviour Architecture: 5-layer target stack, original vs. literature comparison, and host synchronization invariants.
  2. Motivation mathematics: operational meanings, randomized equations, normalization, action ranking, limits and alternatives.
  3. Lifecycle and inheritance: age, competence, overlapping generations, parenting and population control.
  4. Learning and evolution: memory, empirical updates, lessons, future LLM training, validation gates and archive selection.
  5. Evaluation protocol: falsifiable questions, controls and development gates.
  6. Engineering and delivery: source map, interfaces, status and integration.
  7. Research evidence: sources actually inspected and what they do not establish.

docs.title: A brain is more than its equation
docs.text:
The equation sets preferences, not beliefs or abilities. In the baseline, the learner stores context/action outcome estimates. In the proposed neural path, a shared pretrained model generates candidate plans from private observations and evidence-linked memories; the motivational layer ranks those plans. Outcomes revise beliefs and skills, while a promotion gate governs weight updates. No free-form internal monologue is evidence that reasoning or learning occurred.

Four clocks must be distinguished: world ticks, decision count, learning-update count and generation number. Age alone grants neither knowledge nor a larger LoRA rank. A newborn based on a pretrained LLM is locally inexperienced, not linguistically blank or biologically childlike.

docs.title: What exists now
docs.text:
• validated, immutable records and JSON snapshots;
  • seeded birth equations and bounded coefficient inheritance;
  • lifecycle boundaries with terminal expiry;
  • eight-drive context/age/momentum dynamics and normalized ratios;
  • deterministic safe-candidate ranking, using personal experience and capped parental advice;
  • feedback-dependent online numerical updates, finite memory, parent teaching while alive;
  • a capacity-limited phenotype archive with host validation/safety/retention gates;
  • source tests covering these primitives (results must be reported separately).

Implemented in Phase 1.1 & Phase 1.2 (evolzen.environment, evolzen.agents, evolzen.schemas): - SocialSandboxEngine, WorldState/ActionType contracts, TransitionLogStore, SocialSandboxAECEnv, and host adapter (evolzen.environment.adapter). - Unified developmental Agent runtime (evolzen.agents.agent), combining AgentProfile and the 8-coordinate numerical developmental core. - Structured LLM inference (evolzen.agents.inference.TransformersBackend) with outlines-constrained generation and safe deterministic candidate fallback. - CVTArchive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation MAP-Elites scaling across $k$-D behavioral descriptors. - Sandboxed capability self-modification (evolzen.agents.self_modification) gated by evolzen.containment.Sandbox. - PopulationScheduler (evolzen.agents.scheduler) coordinating round-robin stepping, living-parent teaching, and DuckDB transition persistence. - Legacy 5-axis DriveVector stubs cleanly retired per Option A consensus.

Not implemented: multi-generation empirical benchmarking runs on hardware pilot, private LoRA adapter training, and GPU tensor-parallel live serving via VLLMBackend.

docs.title: Upgraded agentic growth workflow architecture
docs.text:
To transition from the deterministic single-agent numerical core to multi-generational population and world growth, all subsystems couple through a six-stage host-mediated lockstep workflow:

flowchart LR
    E["1. Environment Host
(world_tick, State_t, seed,
8-D homeostatic x_t)"] -->|"permitted x_t + Candidate[]"| D["2. Drive & Decision Core
(drive_step W_kj -> MORL p_k;
+ autotelic goal / LLM proposals)"]
    D -->|"pending Decision
(sequence lock)"| S["3. Containment & Execution
(Sandbox + host legality check
& transition replay)"]
    S -->|"verified Outcome
(8-D rewards, evidence_id)"| L["4. Lifetime Learning & Growth
(observe EMA + exploration
synthesis -> RuleLibrary / Manuals)"]
    L -->|"mature snapshots +
verified competence"| A["5. Population QD Archive
(DevelopmentArchive / CVT-MAP-Elites
gated by EvolutionAssessment)"]
    A -->|"diverse parent selection
+ budget check"| G["6. Generational Reproduction
(born inherit_genome + live teach
with parent intact)"]
    G --> E

Design decisions anchoring this upgraded workflow:

  1. MORL + Homeostatic Utility Framing (hayes2022morl, keramati2014homeostatic): drive_step generates normalized priority weights over internal/world discrepancies $x_t$, keeping preference weighting separate from outcome estimation (SkillEstimate) and host legality.
  2. Autotelic & Intrinsic Exploration Track (merrick2010valuesystems, colas2022autotelic, oudeyer2007intrinsic): Because pure greedy ranking stalls in novel environments, exploration proposals (exploration.actor
  3. Candidate generators) feed into the same verified pipeline under matched interaction budgets.
  4. Immutable Memory & Manual Layer (library, economy): Verified skills persist in evolzen.library.RuleLibrary (append-only DuckDB + ValidityContext
  5. RegressionBank), while falsifiable cross-agent knowledge flows via economy.ManualStore and living-parent teach without conflating advice with verified experience.
  6. High-Dimensional QD Scaling (vassiliades2018cvtmape, diversitycollapse2026): Once behavioral descriptors exceed 2–3 dimensions (e.g., risk, reciprocity, specialization, exploration, communication), the archive upgrades from fixed uniform bins to CVT-MAP-Elites while monitoring topology coupling to avoid semantic collapse.
  7. Strict Execution Containment (agache2020firecracker, sidikrokach2026, hyperagents2026): Any code-generating or metacognitive self-modification proposal executes exclusively inside evolzen.containment.Sandbox with static default-deny capability bounds.

See ADR 0006, ADR 0008, and the source package under src/evolzen/agents/.

docs.title: Finalized Agentic Behaviour Architecture
docs.text: Status: Target architecture finalized from IEEE/ML literature audit (November 12, 2026); Tier-0 deterministic numerical core is implemented and tested, while Tier 1–3 upgrades remain proposed and empirically untested pending evolzen.environment integration. Per PRD.md §4 (NG1, NG3), this architecture targets bounded, measurable behavioral convergence, sample efficiency, and multi-agent stability—not AGI.

docs.title: 1. Comparative Analysis: Original Design vs. Research Breakthroughs
docs.text: Original EvolZen Behavior Design Weakness Identified by Literature Research Breakthrough Replacing / Upgrading It Finalized Architectural Decision Fixed 8×8 tendency matrix $W_{kj}$ over "seven sins + Null" (motivation.py) Subjective labels act as LLM prompt confounds; linear activation weights lack causal justification for internal drive dynamics Homeostatic RL (keramati2014homeostatic, eLife 2014) + Compression-Progress Intrinsic Reward (schmidhuber2010creativity, IEEE TAMD 2010) + Empowerment (klyubin2005empowerment, IEEE CEC 2005) Treat $W_{kj}$ strictly as a neutral-label homeostatic priority modulator ablated against intrinsic compression-progress and channel-capacity empowerment controls. Linear MORL scalarization (sum_k p_k * expected_outcome_k - cost) Provably misses Pareto-optimal choices on non-convex fronts (hayes2022morl, AAMAS 2022) Chebyshev Scalarization & Pareto Archives (vanmoffaert2014morl, JMLR 2014) Upgrade utility aggregation to augmented Chebyshev scalarization around a normalized utopia point $z^*$ (keeping linear sum as Tier-0 baseline). Point-estimate EMA + greedy argmax (observe + decide) Zero epistemic uncertainty tracking; traps permanently on suboptimal actions under wrong priors UCB (auer2002ucb1), Thompson Sampling (russo2018thompson), Mellowmax (asadi2017mellowmax, ICML 2017) Add posterior variance / sample uncertainty to SkillEstimate for sublinear regret exploration, plus non-expansive Mellowmax exploration ablations. 1-step myopic candidate ranking (decide) No multi-step counterfactual rollout or temporal credit assignment Expected Free Energy (friston2015epistemic, parr2022activeinference) + DreamerV3 / TD-MPC2 (hafner2025dreamerv3, Nature 2025; hansen2024tdmpc2, ICLR 2024) Route multi-step candidate planning through evolzen.predictor + JEPAEncoder latent MPC rollouts combining epistemic information gain and pragmatic utility. Atomic 1-tick primitive actions only Cannot reuse multi-step procedural skills from RuleLibrary SMDP Options Framework (sutton1999options, AI 1999) + Autotelic Goal Curricula (colas2022autotelic, JAIR 2022) Package verified RuleEntry skills as temporal-abstraction options (I, pi, beta) executed step-by-step under per-tick host legality checks. Independent agents in shared population Independent learners oscillate or collapse to defection in Sequential Social Dilemmas (leibo2017ssd, AAMAS 2017) and suffer semantic collapse (diversitycollapse2026, ACL 2026) LOLA Opponent-Awareness (foerster2018lola, ICLR 2018) + MARL Stability (busoniu2008marl, IEEE TSMC-C 2008) + CVT-MAP-Elites (vassiliades2018cvtmape, IEEE TEVC 2018) Condition policies on observed peer response signals, enforce sparse communication topologies, and scale QD selection via Voronoi cells.

docs.text:
flowchart TB
    L1["Layer 1 — Host & Environment Boundary\n(world_tick, State_t, ExogenousInput_t, seed -> Emission_t, State_{t+1})\nPermitted 8-D homeostatic x_t + Candidate[] + Sandbox permissions"]
    L2["Layer 2 — Value, Preference & Intrinsic Drive\nHomeostatic MORL weights p_k (Chebyshev / linear baseline)\n+ Schmidhuber compression progress + Klyubin Empowerment + Autotelic goals"]
    L3["Layer 3 — Epistemic Uncertainty & Multi-Step Planner\nBayesian/UCB SkillEstimate posterior + Expected Free Energy\n+ Latent MPC rollouts (predictor / JEPA) + SMDP Options over RuleLibrary"]

docs.title: 3. Operational Invariants & Synchronization Rules
docs.text:
1. Lockstep Host Authority: No agent updates beliefs without a host-minted Outcome (in evolzen.schemas.development) matched on (agent_id, sequence, action_id) and deduplicated on evidence_id. Preferences never override Candidate.permitted, age limits, resource budgets, or CapabilityGovernor (in evolzen.containment.governance).
  2. Three Separate Inheritance Channels:
  3. Genetic: Numeric BirthGenome (in evolzen.schemas.development, inherit_genome with bounded mutation; zero weight crossover).
  4. Cultural: Evidence-linked living-parent Lesson items (in evolzen.schemas.development) and falsifiable Manual entries (economy), never credited as own competence samples.
  5. Executable Skills: Immutable, context-scoped RuleEntry records in RuleLibrary (evolzen.library) verified against RegressionBank and executed exclusively inside Sandbox (evolzen.containment.sandbox).
  6. Sequential Social Dilemma Evaluation: All cooperative/competitive drive hypotheses (greed, gluttony, envy, wrath, lust, null) must be evaluated in temporally extended multi-agent runs (leibo2017ssd) reporting resource health, inequality, and extinction—never extrapolated from one-shot static choices.

docs.title: 4. Implementation Status Mapping
docs.text:
• Implemented now (Tier-0): agents/development/ (motivation.py, lifecycle.py, brain.py, learning.py, evolution.py) + schemas/development.py (32 verified test cases) and evolzen.library (77 verified tests).
  • Target upgrades (Proposed / Untested): Tier-1 UCB/Thompson + Chebyshev MORL (ADR 0008), Tier-2 Active Inference / latent MPC in predictor.planner, and Tier-3 SMDP options + opponent-aware MARL in environment / agents. Every tier enters code only with paired ablations against the Tier-0 baseline.

docs.title: Layout and status
docs.text:
Initial numerical-core receipt, October 24, 2026: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/agents/development tests/schemas/test_development.py -q completed successfully: 32 cases passed. This was a targeted source-path run, not a full uv-environment or hardware certification. The three project-wide checks were also attempted once with five-minute limits: ruff check . reported 14 pre-existing findings and one new import-layout finding in tests/schemas/test_development.py; the new finding was corrected without changing test behavior. mypy . could not start because mypy is unavailable. python -m pytest -q stopped with 19 import-collection errors because system Python cannot locate evolzen without the source path/project installation. No full-suite, type-check or docs-build success is claimed. No model training or simulation was run. No failed project check was retried; the import-only test formatting correction was reviewed statically after the passing targeted run.

No source folders are renamed and no existing public interfaces are broken. The developmental implementation is a cohesive subpackage under the existing agents subsystem.

Source Implemented responsibility Companion tests schemas/development.py Closed frozen records, eight coordinates, limits, lineage/snapshot validation tests/schemas/test_development.py agents/development/motivation.py Seeded coefficient generation, bounded equations, inheritance tests/agents/development/test_motivation.py agents/development/lifecycle.py Birth, age stages and parental maturity test_lifecycle.py in the same test folder agents/development/brain.py Candidate ranking, pending decision, clock advancement test_brain.py agents/development/learning.py Trusted receipt update and living-parent advice test_learning.py agents/development/evolution.py Bounded behavior-cell elite archive test_evolution.py Tests mirror each corresponding source owner.

The legacy Agent, five-coordinate DriveVector, InferenceBackend.generate_action, QualityDiversityArchive and AgentLineage signatures remain unchanged. The new API is imported from evolzen.agents.development; new records from evolzen.schemas.development. There is deliberately no lossy automatic eight-to-five drive projection. Old inference/QD helpers do not silently understand the new schema. The new DevelopmentArchive holds developmental snapshots instead of coercing them into legacy entries.

Existing shared-schema importers were inspected across the project. The developmental increment added schemas/development.py alongside existing model fields without changing schemas/__init__.py. Subsequent Phase 1.1 and Phase 1.5 work implemented schemas/world.py (WorldState, WorldSnapshot, CapabilityPackage, ActionType), schemas/library.py (RuleEntry, ValidityContext, VerificationEvidence), storage/transition_log.py (TransitionLogStore), and environment/adapter.py (observe_features, legal_candidates, action_from_candidate, execute_decision); AgentProfile and ProvenanceRecord remain planned.

The root AGENTS.md still summarizes the Phase 0 engineering-scaffold baseline as owner-protected guidance and was left unchanged per repository constraints. Its containment and schema-review rules remain authoritative; use this status map and docs/phases/ for current Phase 1.1, Phase 1.2 numerical-core, and Phase 1.5 implementation scope.

docs.title: Host call sequence
docs.text:
snapshot = born(...)
snapshot = decide(snapshot, permitted_context, candidate_actions, world_tick)
host executes snapshot.pending.candidate using environment and containment
snapshot = observe(snapshot, trusted_outcome_receipt)
host persists the decision/outcome and snapshot
child = born(..., parents=(snapshot,), tick=current_world_tick)
child = teach(snapshot, child, context_key, skill_key, current_world_tick)

The birth call in the last two lines requires a mature living parent. These are API descriptions, not an executable demo or a way around Sandbox. BrainSnapshot.model_dump_json() and BrainSnapshot.model_validate_json() provide serialization; persistent filesystem/database storage and the population scheduler remain pending.

Only the host creates candidate permissions, time, observations, receipts and assessments. The agent may propose content but cannot mark its own outcome verified. Snapshot immutability is not authentication. Persistent receipts need versioned run IDs, signed or protected provenance, exactly-once transition IDs, and crash-safe atomic append before production use.

docs.title: Critical subsystem interfaces
docs.text:
• environment: map legal observations to normalized eight features; execute legal actions; produce independently checked outcome vectors and evidence IDs. Track actual time and needs.
  • economy: enforce resource/birth costs and parent teaching budgets; convert manual evidence into bounded advice records only through host checks.
  • exploration/library: store generated hypotheses and verified skills separately; hypothesis success is not automatically policy competence. Execute generated code only inside Sandbox.
  • predictor: predict future observations/actions, not hidden birth equations unless in a privileged evaluation condition. Scripted drive labels do not establish true mental intent.
  • containment: authority independent of drive scores; no direct filesystem/network capability in the numerical core. Firecracker is a KVM microVM; gVisor is a different isolation design, not a hardware microVM by definition. Backend deployment remains a separate gate.
  • recognition: optional learned proposal prior; cannot promote rules, manipulate evidence or replace the authoritative action validator.
  • evaluation: owns frozen budgets, splits, paired controls and validation receipts. Final test scores never become live evolutionary fitness.

docs.title: Development milestones (not calendar promises)
docs.text:
Milestone Exit evidence Status A0: numerical contracts Source tests for equations, birth, feedback, teaching and archive Implemented; check results reported in delivery, not assumed A1: trusted world integration Child acts in a real typed adapter and receives host-verified feedback; all receipts replayable Host adapter (evolzen.environment.adapter, 7/17 ActionTypes) & TransitionLogStore implemented; population scheduler & multi-generation integration pending A2: living families Budgeted births, overlapping lives, teaching, death and crash-safe history Local primitives only; scheduler pending A3: learned proposals Shared local LLM proposes bounded candidates with no privileged-state leak Pending A4: neural updates Offline private adapters with replay, fixed validation and rollback Pending A5: population evolution Host-selected parents from validated phenotype archive; five-generation study Archive only; scheduler/study pending A6: publication Registered splits, all control conditions, costs and negative results Pending

Start with child-scale tasks such as choosing between immediate consumption, saving, rest, social contact and skill practice. Labels alone must not determine rewards. Add conflicting incentives and scarce information only after the simple choice/feedback/teaching loop is measurable.

docs.title: Hardware and reproducibility
docs.text:
No new dependencies or global settings. Numerical core is CPU-only and allocates no model. Shared quantized base inference, batched agent requests, bounded contexts and private memory are planned. The exact device called “AGX Spark” needs model/SKU confirmation before deployment sizing; do not assume its CUDA, ARM, virtualization or serving support from a nickname. Measure tokens/decision, latency, KV memory, training cadence and storage before choosing population size. One LLM call per simulated physics tick is not the scheduling model.

Persist: full genome, versioned configuration, world and lineage IDs, context schema, action keys, policy/checkpoint hashes, snapshot, pending sequence, teacher evidence and assessment suite. Store secrets outside the repo. A population-wide snapshot must restore all agent clocks and event order, not just individual object state.

docs.title: Developmental-agent evaluation and acceptance
docs.text: Status: proposed protocol, not preregistered results. Integrates with the system evaluation standard. Correct equations and passing tests do not establish developmental intelligence.

docs.title: Questions and primary endpoints
docs.text:
Question Matched comparison Primary measurement Do changing ratios affect behavior? Dynamic equations vs frozen ratios, same contexts/candidates Action-distribution change under one-feature interventions Is the eight-axis ontology useful? Eight axes vs legacy five, uniform and random eight-feature controls Held-out task return and observed behavioral coverage per interaction Is Null distinct from sloth? Null disabled vs explicit Null, while cost is held fixed Voluntary abstention at equal action effort; world survival/health Does an individual learn? observe enabled vs frozen estimates, same initial genome Held-out error and regret over successive experience blocks Is age more than a timer? Aged without experience vs trained at fixed age vs both Age-controlled skill acquisition and retention Does living-parent teaching help? No teaching, parent advice, unrelated teacher, shuffled advice Child interactions to criterion and transfer to different instances Is knowledge cumulative? Overlapping generations vs reset-culture generations Success across generations at equal total interactions and teaching cost Does evolution preserve diversity? QD vs fitness-only vs random parent selection Behavior coverage, lineage concentration, extinction and useful performance Are LLM updates worthwhile? Frozen base, memory-only, private adapter Transfer, retention, inference/training cost; planned, not baseline capability Is linear MORL scalarization sufficient? (hayes2022morl) Linear weighted sum vs Chebyshev / non-linear scalarization Pareto coverage, safety-constraint violations, and non-convex trade-off survival Does an intrinsic value system outperform greedy drives? (merrick2010valuesystems, colas2022autotelic) Greedy 8-drive vs competence-progress / prediction-error intrinsic drive vs combined Unique skills acquired, world-growth categories triggered, and exploration efficiency Should action choice be stochastic? (asadi2017mellowmax) Deterministic argmax (decide) vs Boltzmann softmax vs Mellowmax temperature policy Policy stability, exploration coverage, and variance across seeds

Test one causal factor at a time before attempting a full factorial study. The seven-sins names themselves are a potential language-model prompt confound: compare neutral labels with identical numerical features. Do not interpret label effects as a psychological discovery.

docs.title: Proposed pilot protocol
docs.text:
• Begin with deterministic scripted candidates and world outcomes; no LLM and no self-modified code.
  • Use 5 development seeds for engineering only, then 10 independent population seeds for the pilot. These are proposed budgets, not a power calculation. Estimate variance before freezing a final run count, minimum useful effect and non-inferiority margin.
  • Start with 4 agents for integration; 10–30 is a later hardware-measured population target.
  • Run at least 5 overlapping generations for the cultural-transfer pilot; normalize by total world interactions, including teacher time. A generational comparison with extra experience cannot establish cultural advantage.
  • Pair control conditions on world seeds and initial genomes. Hold model, candidate pool, parameter/context budget and retrieved information fixed where applicable.
  • Split worlds by mechanics and lineages, not random transitions from the same life. Final evaluation freezes manual store, archive, adapters and hyperparameters before execution.
  • Reuse sealed final instances across independently reset comparison conditions when needed for paired estimates; never feed their scores into tuning or evolving policies. A fresh seed alone is not a novel mechanism.

docs.title: Metrics with definitions
docs.text:
For fixed action budget B, success means satisfying the domain's evaluator-owned criterion within B actions. Report success rate, actions-to-success conditional on success, and failure/censoring count. A proposed bounded local efficiency summary is:

EAE_B = mean(success_i * max(0, 1 - (actions_i - 1) / B))

Require B >= 1 and actions in [1,B]; count failed/invalid/abstained episodes as zero. This is an explicit proposed local score, not implemented by RHAEScorer and not an official benchmark. Always publish raw costs and success rates alongside it; it can hide tradeoffs if used alone. Count wait as an action; include inference tokens, teacher actions, wall time and energy if measured.

For learning, define forgetting for each prior task as its best earlier validation score minus its current score (also report signed backward transfer); report average and worst task separately. Measure retention on fixed versioned tasks, not changed world rules. An estimate surviving in a dictionary is not retained competence.

For diversity, report occupied cells / predeclared reachable cell count, visitation distribution, trajectory-based behavior descriptors, and lineage shares. The number of different random seeds or coefficient vectors does not prove behavioral diversity. Use a small descriptor grid to avoid sparsity in eight dimensions; v1 archive defaults to two measured dimensions.

For growth, count artifacts/institutions only when independently useful and persistent under a declared window. Creating records or repeating identical objects is not meaningful novelty.

docs.title: Verification gates before any population result
docs.text:
1. Finite normalized drives, reproducible birth, strict input bounds and schema round trips.
  2. All stage boundaries, monotonic age, no resurrection; no auto-created skills on age advancement.
  3. Pending receipt identity, verified provenance, duplicate protection and failure atomicity.
  4. Live parent teaching, no parent-memory destruction, no mastery credit from advice alone.
  5. Direct feedback changes behavior; bad lessons can be overridden by the child's experience.
  6. Archive safety/retention/suite gates, capacity, same-cell replacement and preserved lineage.
  7. Integration against trusted transition receipts, external deduplication, world permissions, persistent logs and sandbox backend before generated policies are enabled.

Source tests cover the numerical primitives, not gates 7 or empirical outcomes. Final reports must distinguish proposed, implemented, tested and experimentally supported behavior.

docs.title: Statistical reporting and stop conditions
docs.text: Use the population seed/run as the independent unit, not correlated agent ticks. Report paired seed differences and 95% interval estimates at run level; freeze the resampling method before final evaluation. Include every run, timeout, extinction and excluded datum with reasons. Abort on nonfinite state, identity mismatch, invalid authoritative transitions, containment failures or exhausted host budgets. A null/negative effect is publishable if the experiment is sufficiently powered and well controlled; it is not proof that all developmental-agent approaches fail.
